generation.scope: On one open containing the rational full-rank sample, the full center is a geometrically integral normal quartic hypersurface on five quartic generators. The folded algebra is prime of PI degree 16, and its central quotient is a 4 by 4 matrix algebra over a degree-four central division algebra. All composable nonzero paths have nonzero product there. All standard AS specializations of the component satisfy the sharper standard identity s32.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed integral transfer on the finite filtered Rees components, saturation of four independent central powers, interpolation on the plane, trace semisimplicity, Morita ranks and the homogeneous right-ideal divisibility argument.

mathematical_computation.scope: Filtered paths through length 16 at the zero parameters and six nonzero parameter fibers modulo 1009. Center commutator kernel dimension four, corner trace rank 64, squarefree quartic, and a geometrically smooth projective plane section.

open_mathematics: Determine how the quartic center degenerates at the symmetric divisor: compute the degree-eight center, test a double cover of a quadric, and stratify the non-Azumaya locus. Continue finite AS tests on the component boundary.
